summary: Verified 502 login bug fix. Backend /api/v1/auth/login returns 200 with access_token; mbstring-dependent endpoints (customers search, service-plans) work; frontend login redirects admin to /dashboard with no 502 toast.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthController login enforces a min password length of 8 via validation, so wrong-password attempts under 8 chars return 422 instead of 401 - acceptable but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses Vite (VITE_API_URL in /app/frontend/.env), not CRA. Backend is Laravel served by supervisor `laravel` process on :8001. All /api routes proxied through ingress. Login endpoint validation requires password >= 8 chars.
rca of the issue: Supervisor started PHP built-in server before dpkg triggers enabled mbstring. Fixed by run_laravel.sh now waiting for pdo_pgsql, mbstring, openssl, tokenizer, json, bcmath, curl, xml extensions before starting the server, and by restarting the laravel supervisor process. Verified: login 200, mbstring endpoints working.
